g.text: O1/O2 populated rear faces: proposed millimetres, not PCB routing or physical qualification
Green: all154 source core packages per populated tile. Orange: DIN96, power, supports, guides, probes.
Red: six rear axial calibration tool sweeps per oscillator. Grey O3–O5 are reservations, not placements.
Side datums: panel0 / middle50 / core69.2 / inner cover105mm.
DIN stack 19.2±0.3mm; pull handles project18mm; remove cover, withdraw40mm.
Front J/P and alternating octave boards retain locked panel centres; rear tile pitch is independent.
Adjustment needs a1.7mm cross tip, not fingers between boards.100mm open rear work depth allocated.
